rationale: Minimum feasible pickup is set by the load-avoidance constraint: 420 A * 1.2 = 504 A primary (5.04 A secondary at CT ratio 100, within the 1-10 A device range). This also satisfies sensitivity: 1800/504 = 3.57 >= 1.5. Choosing the lowest allowable pickup maximizes the sensitivity factor while still avoiding load operation. Time delay is set at the coordination minimum: downstream 0.35 s + selectivity margin 0.30 s = 0.65 s, within the 0-2 s range.
